idea-plugin.name: Commit Splitter
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful IntelliJ IDEA plugin that allows you to split a single git commit into multiple commits assigned to different users.
Features: - Right-click on any commit to split it - Intelligent splitting strategies: by files, hunks, or lines - Configure multiple users with usernames and emails - Progressive commit creation maintaining git history - Visual progress tracking
Perfect for collaborative development and code review scenarios.

action.description: Split this commit into multiple commits for different users
